title: Lymphatic drainage massage: separating fact from fiction
excerpts: Lymphatic drainage massage does not directly cause weight loss
However, there is no evidence that MLD causes weight loss.
There is no credible evidence showing that MLD in healthy people leads to additional benefits in those areas.

title: What lymphatic drainage massage actually does for your body
excerpts: As far as influencers’ claims that lymphatic drainage can help you lose weight, Rockson says it has nothing to do with weight loss.
Cellulite is fluid retention within fat, so lymphatic drainage can temporarily smooth out cellulite, but it won’t affect body weight as measured on a scale.
The claims that lymphatic massage can get rid of toxins are unfounded as well, adds Rockson.
